## Decisions

- **Drag-safe click via pointerdown/up displacement threshold (6px)**: TaskCard acts as a dnd-kit draggable handle (asHandle); a plain onClick fires on drag release, so measuring delta ensures genuine clicks only.
- **Task detail uses Dialog rather than Sheet**: Maintains consistency with every existing form in the app (NewTaskDialog, EntryFormDialog, CategoryDialog).
- **Finance section is omitted entirely from DOM when !canReadFinance**: AC explicitly states 'absent, not empty, for a caller without finance.read' to prevent leaking metadata.
